title: Microsoft Purview: allow version trimming for content under retention in SharePoint and OneDrive
summary: The roadmap facts and documented version-management controls are supported, and independent searches found no documentation for the planned retention override. Minor clarifications remain about conflicting tenant-trimming documentation and the separate runs required for Multi-Geo tenants.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans a Purview Data Lifecycle Management setting permitting version trimming on OneDrive and SharePoint content under retention policies.
claims.quote: Admins with appropriate Purview RBAC can enable version cleanup for ODB/SPO content even when retention policies are in effect.
